name: GOLDLI
recent: Gold Li 公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度业绩，录得净亏损 388.6 万令吉，营收 700.3 万令吉。公司表示，受 IPO 费用影响，预计 FY27 财务表现将面临挑战。此外，公司于 9 月 18 日更改了注册地址。

recent_en: Gold Li reported a quarterly net loss of RM3.886 million on revenue of RM7.003 million for the period ended 31 July 2026. The company said it expects FY27 financial performance to be challenging, partly due to IPO expenses. It also changed its registered address on 18 September.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026 with a net loss of RM3.886 million.
The company expects FY27 financial performance to be challenging.
risks_en: Quarterly net loss of RM3.886 million with a net margin of -55.5%.
IPO expenses affected the quarterly results.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM7.003 million and net loss was RM3.886 million, with a net margin of -55.5%.
